resources.string: Say “Hello NEX”, then just talk. No wake phrase needed between answers.

NEX listens only after you allow the microphone, and only while the app is open.
The camera is used only when you ask about something in front of you, for one question.
Coarse location is asked for only when you want your local weather. Never in the background.

Camera permission is off, so NEX cannot look.
NEX never asks for contacts, SMS, call logs, storage, accessibility, notifications or background location.
